```plato
//==
// # Scientific data
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Tables, measurements, and dataset metadata
//  - Data series

//==
// # Tables, measurements, and dataset metadata
//
// Rectangular tables of typed columns, individual measurement records with
// uncertainty, and the descriptive records that identify a dataset, its sensor
// channels, and their calibration. Values carry their units explicitly via
// UnitOfMeasure rather than through the type system.

//==
// # Tables

// The typed values of a table column: exactly one element type, carried by
// the matching case.
type ColumnValues
    = Numbers(Values: Array<Number>)
    | Integers(Values: Array<Integer>)
    | Strings(Values: Array<String>)
    | Booleans(Values: Array<Boolean>)
    | Instants(Values: Array<Instant>);
```
